target.title: test(infra): make Windows-render and late-SQLite guard tests pass on macOS hosts
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #100025. Two infra tests fail deterministically on any pristine macOS checkout of `main` (Linux CI green on the same SHA), which breaks the `scripts/pr prepare-run` local `pnpm test` gate on maintainer Macs.

## Why This Change Was Made

Both failures are test-environment assumptions, not product bugs:

- `src/infra/exec-approvals-analysis.test.ts` resolves the real host `python3`; Homebrew's `/opt/homebrew/Cellar/python@3.14/.../bin/python3.14` contains `@`, so the enforced-command renderer correctly quotes the executable, and the assertion regex rejected the closing quote. The regex now allows an optional `"` before the script argument.
- `src/infra/backup-create.test.ts` injects a late SQLite file from an `fs.readdir` spy keyed on `path.resolve(state.stateDir)`. Snapshot discovery scans the realpathed dir, and on macOS the tmpdir-based state dir goes through the `/var -> /private/var` symlink, so the spy never fired and the guard had nothing to catch. The spy now also compares against `fs.realpath(state.stateDir)`.

## User Impact

None at runtime (test-only). Maintainers can land PRs from macOS again: `pnpm test` infra shard goes green on a clean checkout of `main`.

## Evidence

On macOS (Darwin 25.5), pristine clone of `main`, before: 3 failed (2 late-SQLite variants + Windows-render). After:

```
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.infra.config.ts src/infra/exec-approvals-analysis.test.ts src/infra/backup-create.test.ts
Test Files  2 passed (2)
Tests  59 passed (59)
```

Linux behavior is unchanged (`/tmp` is not a symlink; `/usr/bin/python3` needs no quoting) — CI on this PR is the Linux proof.
